verdict.rationale: Convex documents a dev deployment that is separate from production: `npx convex dev` pushes schema and function changes there and regenerates types, and `npx convex run` executes functions against it (convex-docs-17, convex-docs-18). Its official MCP server lets agents work with deployments and by default cannot touch production (convex-docs-10, convex-docs-28), so an agent can change and exercise a schema in isolation before prod. Missing for 10: per-branch or preview deployments, a documented workflow for promoting tested schema changes to production, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven schema testing.
